paper_title: (Almost) Closing the $ν$MSM Sterile Neutrino Dark Matter Window with NuSTAR
notes: This paper constrains sterile neutrino dark matter in the mass-mixing angle plane (m_chi vs sin^2(2theta)) from X-ray line searches with NuSTAR. This is not one of the supported coupling types (axion/dark photon/scalar couplings). The relevant result is a decay rate limit / mixing angle limit for sterile neutrinos, which does not map onto any enum value. Local DM density of 0.4 GeV/cm^3 is assumed.
